adaptations.whatChanged: The video shows a coloring dropdown on the voronoi node reading intensity, which switched between greyscale and cells, but this version has no such dropdown because the node outputs a color directly.
the video picks cells from a coloring dropdown on the voronoi node, but this version has no such dropdown and the node already outputs flat coloured cells, which the cube shows.
the video drags from a grey fac output on the voronoi node, but this version has no fac output, and its greyscale number output is called distance, the top output dot.
